# AI-Driven Development — Repository Context

This repository contains a **methodology** and a **cross-tool plugin** for
AI-assisted software quality verification.

## What this repo is

- Markdown documents describing the methodology (docs/)
- A plugin with skills and agents for Copilot and Claude Code (plugin/)
- Specs for planned tooling (specs/)
- Open source under CC BY 4.0

## What this repo is NOT

- Not a framework, library, or installable package
- Not tied to any specific language, platform, or protocol
- Not a code generation methodology — it is a verification discipline

## How to work with this repo

- Follow the principles in `docs/002-principles.md`: brief, alive, structured,
  opinionated, enforceable
- One concept per file. Replace outdated content — do not append history
- Keep docs short enough to read in one sitting
- Every recommendation should have a clear position
- Use plain language. No marketing copy, no filler
- No em dashes. Use " — " (space-hyphen-hyphen-space) or rephrase

## Repository structure

- `docs/` — Methodology specification (numbered, sequential)
- `plugin/` — Cross-tool plugin (skills, agents, manifests)
- `specs/` — Tooling specifications (trace analyzer)
- `.github/` — GitHub config and AI instructions

## Companion

The blog at https://givikdev.github.io/ai-driven-development/ provides concise
summaries of each section and links back here for full documentation.
